# synthetic fixture mimicking `tar --help` (GNU tar is GPL-3.0; format
# reproduced by hand, no verbatim capture — see ../NOTICE.md)
Usage: jym-tar [OPTION...] [FILE]...

Examples:
  jym-tar -cf archive.tar foo bar
  jym-tar -xf archive.tar

 Main operation mode:
  -A, --catenate        append files to an archive
  -c, --create          create a new archive
  -t, --list            list the contents of an archive
  -x, --extract         extract files from an archive

Suffixes accepted by --quoting-style:
       none       no quoting
       t          table quoting
       nil        no style
       never      never quote
       literal    quote literally
